top.query:
SELECT json_build_object($1,clock_timestamp(),
      $2,(SELECT count(*) FROM tbooker.outbox_events WHERE status<>$3),
      $4,(SELECT count(*) FROM tbooker.outbox_events WHERE status=$5),
      $6,(SELECT count(*) FROM tbooker.bookings),
      $7,(SELECT count(*) FROM tbooker.processed_events),
      $8,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name IN ($9,$10)),
      $11,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name IN ($12,$13) AND state=$14),
      $15,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name IN ($16,$17) AND wait_event_type=$18))

select ms1_0.id,ms1_0.movie_id,m1_0.id,m1_0.duration_minutes,m1_0.title,ms1_0.screen_id,s1_0.id,s1_0.name,s1_0.theatre_id,t1_0.id,t1_0.city,t1_0.name,ms1_0.start_time from tbooker.movie_shows ms1_0 join tbooker.movies m1_0 on m1_0.id=ms1_0.movie_id join tbooker.screens s1_0 on s1_0.id=ms1_0.screen_id join tbooker.theatres t1_0 on t1_0.id=s1_0.theatre_id where ms1_0.id=$1

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT event_id FROM tbooker.outbox_events
    WHERE (status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp())
       OR (status='IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
    ORDER BY created_at,event_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $1
)
UPDATE tbooker.outbox_events e SET status='IN_FLIGHT',lease_token=$2,
    lease_until=clock_timestamp()+($3 * interval '1 millisecond'),attempts=attempts+1
FROM candidates c WHERE e.event_id=c.event_id
RETURNING e.event_id,e.aggregate_id,e.payload::text,e.created_at,e.attempts,e.lease_token

select ms1_0.id,ms1_0.movie_id,m1_0.id,m1_0.duration_minutes,m1_0.title,ms1_0.screen_id,s1_0.id,s1_0.name,s1_0.theatre_id,t1_0.id,t1_0.city,t1_0.name,ms1_0.start_time from tbooker.movie_shows ms1_0 join tbooker.movies m1_0 on m1_0.id=ms1_0.movie_id join tbooker.screens s1_0 on s1_0.id=ms1_0.screen_id join tbooker.theatres t1_0 on t1_0.id=s1_0.theatre_id order by ms1_0.start_time,ms1_0.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbooker.outbox_events WHERE status<>$1

SELECT c.oid, a.attnum, a.attname, c.relname, n.nspname, a.attnotnull OR (t.typtype = $1 AND t.typnotnull), a.attidentity != $2 OR pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) LIKE $3 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON (c.relnamespace = n.oid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON (c.oid = a.attrelid) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_type t ON (a.atttypid = t.oid) LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d ON (d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum) JOIN (SELECT $4 AS oid , $5 AS attnum) vals ON (c.oid = vals.oid AND a.attnum = vals.attnum) where c.oid in ($6)

SELECT s.id FROM tbooker.show_seats s
JOIN tbooker.reservations r ON r.show_seat_id = s.id
WHERE s.status = $1 AND r.status = $2 AND r.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
ORDER BY r.expires_at, s.id LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
